key_insight: GALÆXI shows that a DGSEM-based CFD solver can be effectively adapted to AMD MI300A APUs while preserving the accuracy needed for large eddy simulation of complex turbulent flows.
engineering_relevance: The work supports exascale-ready, heterogeneous CFD for aerospace and turbomachinery applications by combining hardware-aware optimization with validated wall-modeled and wall-resolved LES capability.
method: Benchmarked GALÆXI on AMD MI300A APUs using strong and weak scaling tests and partitioning-mode comparisons.
Integrated wall-modeled LES algorithms into the GPU-accelerated DGSEM framework.
Validated the solver on a plane turbulent channel and demonstrated it on a transonic compressor cascade with shock/boundary-layer interaction.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports scaling evaluations on Hunter’s MI300A APUs plus physical validation in a turbulent channel and a demanding transonic compressor cascade case.
watch_item: Performance gains may depend strongly on APU partitioning mode and hardware-specific tuning, which could affect portability across other accelerators.
paper_title: APU-Accelerated Large Eddy Simulation with the Discontinuous Galerkin Solver GALÆXI
